data_source: ECMWF IFS ENS 50 members via WeatherBench 2 (64x32, 5.625 deg), Z500

alert_threshold.definition: FULL model probability giving 10% false-alarm rate on VALIDATION (product threshold)

priority_formula.formula: score = p_bust * 0.5**((lead_day-1)/H) * evidence_weight + B * max(0, p_bust - p_B2)
priority_formula.note: Product triage rule; weights are design choices, not fitted or validated constants.

attribution_note: TreeSHAP contributions (log-odds, before isotonic calibration). They describe what the model used; they are associations, not physical causes.

evidence.text: Z500 ensemble spread 1.9 m = 57th percentile of training spread for this region, lead day and season; member anomaly-sign agreement 86%.
Forecast Z500 anomaly -2 m (|anomaly| at the 8th training percentile); pattern distance from the training mean 2.82 (PC units).

Of the 30 most similar verified historical forecast states for this region and lead day (1578 verified cases available; 101 within the similarity radius), 10% exceeded the bust threshold (climatological rate 10%).
Versus the cycle 24 h earlier (same valid time) the regional Z500 forecast moved 1.3 m (neighbourhood RMS revision 1.8 m, 28th training percentile).
Over the 5 days before initialisation, verified Day 1-3 forecasts for this region had mean normalized error 0.17 (mean error +0.0 m; 7% busts, n = 14); neighbouring regions 0.21, whole domain 0.15.
Sentinel 9% vs calibrated spread-only baseline 7% (+2 percentage points).
